name: Milestone timeline · current status against baseline
purpose: A weekly axis with a Magenta today line: done milestones are filled, upcoming ones hollow, and a slipped milestone shows a ghost diamond at its baseline with a dashed arrow to its forecast. Beneath, a status table gives baseline, forecast, variance and status per milestone, beside a variance note.
